bagPolicy.summary: Backpacks of any kind are prohibited. The Exit/In FAQ does not list a maximum dimension or clear requirement for other bags.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Nearby paid options include a garage across from the venue and a lot behind it on Louise Avenue; street spaces on Louise and Elliston Place are limited.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue recommends rideshare because parking is limited, but its FAQ does not designate a specific pickup or drop-off curb.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Outside food and beverages are prohibited. An outdoor smoking area is available to the left of the room.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The venue is mainly standing room, with a limited number of seats available first come first served. Contact the venue before the show for ADA accommodations.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Buy tickets online through TicketWeb or at the box office when doors open. The box office is cashless, so bring a debit or credit card; a cash-to-card exchange there can give you a prepaid card.

gates.summary: The venue is at 2208 Elliston Place. Concert door times appear on the venue calendar, and the box office opens at doors.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
